“哎呀，都一样都一样，你快坐下，我给你洗脚。”
赵大柱说着就抓住李玉娇的一只小脚拽到自己面前。
“别看了，你要帮我洗就赶紧洗，别……别磨磨蹭蹭的。”
赵大柱笑呵呵的点头，这才终于恋恋不舍的将高跟鞋从李玉娇的脚上摘了下来。
将李玉娇的两只白嫩美脚按在水盆里，赵大柱就微微用力，为她揉搓。
不过李玉娇的脚本来就干干净净，甚至还香喷喷的，有一股子香皂的清香味道。
所以赵大柱都揉搓半天了，也没有从李玉娇的脚上搓下来什么污垢，洗脚盆里的水也依旧清澈见底。
“你们女人的脚，跟我们男人就是不一样，这皮肤滑溜的都没话说了。”
赵大柱忍不住赞叹起来，笑的合不拢嘴。
可害羞的同时，李玉娇心头热乎乎的。
自从她长大以后，就再也没有人帮她洗脚了。
这种异样的滋味，她自然也就再没有品尝过。
此时此刻，看着赵大柱这个糟老头蹲在地上，一丝不苟的搓洗自己的脚丫。
李玉娇的脑海中不禁浮现起了许多年前，她老爹给她洗脚的场景。
那已经是很多年以前的事情了，久远的时间令她的记忆都快模糊了。
那时候的她还是个小孩子，但她老爹已经和赵大柱一样头发斑白，满脸皱纹。
回想着老爹帮自己洗脚时，那一脸宠溺的神情，李玉娇忽然觉得眼前的赵大柱和自己老爹好像一模一样，至少有七八分相像。
想到这里，李玉娇的心儿便不由得颤抖起来，胸口好像憋着一股子难以言说的情绪无法发泄出来。

“对了，玉娇你来我家好像没有带拖鞋？那我明天去村口超市帮你买一双，给你买那种纯棉的。”
“你的脚这么白这么嫩，穿纯棉的最好了，肯定不会伤到皮肤……”
赵大柱啰里啰嗦的说道，红光满面的样子就好像年轻了十七八岁。
而李玉娇逐渐从回忆之中回过神来，便再也无法忍耐心中的情感了。
她忽然扑到了赵大柱的身上，用两条胳膊紧紧的环绕住赵大柱的脖子。
也不知道过去了多长时间，赵大柱和李玉娇才终于平静下来。
看着宛如一只小猫咪似的依偎在自己怀里的李玉娇，赵大柱心里满足的不得了，但同时还有点奇怪的感觉。
这都是因为李玉娇之前梦呓似的叫了声老公。
赵大柱不知道该怎么问，他犹犹豫豫了好一阵子，终于大着胆子问道：“玉娇，你还记不记得，我抱你上床的时候你叫我什么了？”
李玉娇闭着眼睛慢悠悠的问道，似乎还在回味刚才赵大柱带给她的快乐。
“你叫了我一声老公。”赵大柱说道。
李玉娇一双美目刷的一下睁开，并对赵大柱投来了震惊、羞臊、不敢相信的眼神。
“我没胡说，你当时确实管我叫老公了，我听的很清楚。”赵大柱说道。
李玉娇的话还没有说完，赵大柱就抢着说道：“你有，你就是叫了，我都听见了。”
顿了顿，赵大柱又说道：“虽然我老了，今年都五十二了，可我眼没瞎，耳没聋，你叫的那一声我听的千真万确，绝对没有听错。”
看着赵大柱那热忱的眼神，那期待的神情，李玉娇扭捏了好半天，终于叫了一声老公。
李玉娇的这一声老公，赵大柱真是听在耳里，喜在心里。
他甚至觉得自己这一身老骨头，都随着她的那一声老公，变得酥软了，融化了。
虽然早就已经得到了李玉娇，但他现在才觉得，这个女人从心灵到身体都是属于自己的了。

> Chapter 21 A Husband (Page 1)
"Oh, it's all the same. Sit down quickly and I'll wash your feet."
As Zhao Dazhu spoke, he grabbed one of Li Yujiao's feet and pulled it in front of him.
"Stop looking. If you want to help me wash it, wash it quickly. Don't... don't take your time."
Zhao Dazhu nodded with a smile, and then reluctantly took off the high heels from Li Yujiao's feet.
Pressing Li Yujiao's two beautiful white feet into the basin, Zhao Dazhu rubbed her with a little force.
However, Li Yujiao's script is clean and even fragrant, with the fragrance of soap.
So Zhao Dazhu had been rubbing for a long time, but no dirt came off Li Yujiao's feet, and the water in the footbath was still crystal clear.
"You women's feet are just different from us men's. The skin is so slippery that there's nothing to say about it."
Zhao Dazhu couldn't help but admire it and smiled from ear to ear.
But while she was shy, Li Yujiao felt warm in her heart.
Since she grew up, no one has washed her feet.
Naturally, she had never tasted this strange taste again.
At this moment, he watched Zhao Dazhu, a bad old man, squatting on the ground and meticulously scrubbing his feet.
Li Yujiao couldn't help but recall the scene where her father washed her feet many years ago.
That was many years ago, and her memory was almost blurred by the long time.
She was still a child at that time, but her father was already as gray-haired and wrinkled as Zhao Dazhu.
Recalling the doting look on her father's face when he washed her feet, Li Yujiao suddenly felt that Zhao Dazhu in front of her looked exactly like her father, at least 70-80% similar.
Thinking of this, Li Yujiao's heart couldn't help but tremble, as if there was an unspeakable emotion held in her chest that she couldn't vent.
"By the way, Yujiao, you didn't bring slippers when you came to my house? Then I'll go to the village entrance supermarket to buy a pair for you tomorrow. I'll buy you the pure cotton ones."
"Your feet are so white and tender. It's best to wear pure cotton. It will definitely not hurt the skin..."
Zhao Dazhu said in a long voice, his face glowing red as if he was seventeen or eighteen years younger.
But Li Yujiao gradually recovered from the memories, and she could no longer bear the emotions in her heart.
She suddenly jumped on Zhao Dazhu's body and wrapped her arms tightly around Zhao Dazhu's neck.
I don’t know how much time passed before Zhao Dazhu and Li Yujiao finally calmed down.
Looking at Li Yujiao nestling in his arms like a little kitten, Zhao Dazhu felt extremely satisfied, but at the same time he still felt a little strange.
This is all because Li Yujiao called her husband in a sleepy voice before.
Zhao Dazhu didn't know how to ask. He hesitated for a while, and finally asked boldly: "Yujiao, do you still remember what you called me when I carried you to bed?"
Li Yujiao asked slowly with her eyes closed, as if she was still recalling the happiness that Zhao Dazhu had brought to her just now.
"You called me husband." Zhao Dazhu said.
Li Yujiao's beautiful eyes suddenly opened, and she cast a look of shock, embarrassment, and disbelief at Zhao Dazhu.
"I'm not talking nonsense. You did call me husband at that time. I heard it very clearly." Zhao Dazhu said.
Before Li Yujiao finished speaking, Zhao Dazhu rushed to say: "You are, you just screamed, I heard you."
After a pause, Zhao Dazhu said again: "Although I am old, I am fifty-two this year, but I am not blind or deaf. I heard the sound you screamed absolutely correctly, and I definitely heard it correctly."
Looking at Zhao Dazhu's enthusiastic eyes and expectant look, Li YuAfter coquettishly for a long time, she finally called her husband.
Zhao Dazhu really heard Li Yujiao's words of "husband" and felt happy in his heart.
He even felt that his old bones had softened and melted with her voice.
Although he had already obtained Li Yujiao, he now felt that this woman belonged to him from mind to body.
